purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a reserve-house covenant dispute inside Cistern House Nine.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for ordinary pump work, covenant review, supply interruption, physical compatibility evidence, creditor leverage, the final seal decision, and four state-gated ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the pump-house establishing frame, the covenant-table routine, each opening evidence action, the black-edged supply notice, the sealed coffer response, the revealed amendment, the leverage choice, the final threshold, and each ending family. The arrival of the supply notice and the first view of the sealed coffer are separate beats.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base image prompt restates visible geometry, materials, light, objects, and the bodies in frame for a general image model. Character refs are assembled only for the named characters or group declared visible. Continuity notes remain reviewer and tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink drawing with restrained watercolor, worn brass and dark carved stone, warm amber lamps against cold blue mana light, clear silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical magical machinery, civic paperwork rendered as metal strips and chalk marks, cinematic interactive-fiction framing.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual_character_refs only for visible_characters in that scene, and all triggered state_image_modifiers and global_branch_image_modifiers. Each assembled prompt is complete and independent of prior images.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture revisits one two-level pump house from several focal distances. The embedded map fixes zones, sightlines, camera slots, coffer custody, and gauge bands for B-level draft replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For high-consistency website art, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout using the embedded scene_set before generating multiple camera angles.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a two-level underground public pump house carved into dark stone beside a warm subterranean sea. A dry upper gallery opens to a street landing; a grated iron stair descends to a misty wet intake chamber. Three squat brass-and-iron pump engines stand behind waist-high brass safety rails with glass pressure floats and outlet valves. A locked arched conduit enters through the gallery wall, a chain hoist hangs above a marked dry delivery square, and a black public gauge slate stands beside rows of copper water cans. Amber oil lamps and cold blue mana channels light the worn stone. The pumps are running steadily and the landing queue is orderly.

visible_characters.default_stance: compact dwarf householders and public workers waiting with copper cans beyond the yellow line

visual_continuity_notes: The street landing and public slate are above and outside the yellow access line; the pump row and conduit arch are inside the dry gallery; the wet intake is visible only through the grated stair opening.
The three pumps remain ordered Engine One, Engine Two, Engine Three from left to right when viewed from the landing.

characters.hessa_cairn: Master Hessa Cairn: middle-aged dwarf woman, very short and square-shouldered, deep brown skin, iron-gray hair cropped close around a single long temple braid, severe rectangular face, dark green wool workshop coat with brass toggles, heavy civic seal carved with a stepped-water mark on a belt chain, still hands and economical expressions.

characters.orsa_rill: Orsa Rill: young adult dwarf apprentice, compact broad-hipped build, warm brown skin, round face with a small scar through the left eyebrow, dark copper hair in one thick practical braid wrapped in gray cord, short sleeveless indigo work coat over a cream shirt, leather apron, heavy ankle boots, chalk and blue mana stains on square fingertips, alert posture that becomes deliberately still when challenged.
characters.brin_olt: Brin Olt: adult dwarf journeyworker, stocky muscular build, ruddy tan skin, broad nose, auburn beard divided into two short forks bound with brass rings, rolled slate-blue sleeves, oil-dark leather apron, thick gloves tucked at belt, cautious rail-side stance and practical protective reach.
characters.dema_sorn: Dema Sorn: middle-aged dwarf landing clerk, narrow sturdy build, pale olive skin, black hair threaded with gray and tied under a rust-red headscarf, charcoal vest over a striped brown shirt, large chalk holster, black level slate carried against one hip, observant posture oriented toward both gauges and public witnesses.
